title: Skull Cap Gloss Black

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Daytona Skull Cap Gloss Black delivers stripped-down minimalist coverage for relaxed warm-weather cruising, pairing low-profile styling with essential certified head protection. Built around a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell weighing 1420g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~99 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across DOT benchmarks. The interior features a plush, moisture-wicking crown liner shaped for Round Oval head shapes, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for effortless warm-weather riding.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Gloss Black finish; Daytona Skull Cap style.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.

Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

introduction: Positioned in Daytona's Half lineup, the Skull Cap Gloss Black brings Global Premium engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for a Round Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT track safety.
story:
The Daytona Skull Cap Gloss Black represents Daytona's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~99 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Half helmet tailored to a Round Oval head shape, the Daytona Skull Cap Gloss Black delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
